answer: The seat wakes by post. Enrolment prints a six-digit code under a scratch panel and mails it signature-required to a normalised address, keeping the seat shut until the code returns. A second claim on the same delivery point returns the first seat; suite numbers and drop boxes collapse, returned mail voids the claim, codes expire in nine days. A thousand clones need a thousand doors on a thousand routes, $34 a month each plus $6 postage, staffed to sign. An atlas lists streets, not tenants, and at the sun's nadir the yarrow in a real yard still marks whose window the postman knocks on.
